privacyPolicy.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPolicy.subtitle: No data collected. No tracking. No exceptions.
privacyPolicy.manifestoTitle: Your data is NOT our product.
privacyPolicy.manifestoText: YT Deluxe does not collect, store, or sell any personal data. We believe media consumption should be a private act of freedom.
privacyPolicy.section1: What We Do and Do Not Collect
privacyPolicy.q1Text: We collect minimal data required for functionality: YouTube URLs you submit, selected quality preferences, and your download history (optional). We do NOT collect personal identifications, IP addresses for tracking, or browsing behavior.
privacyPolicy.q2Text: Your data stays on your own device. On Web, download history is stored in your browser's localStorage. On Windows Desktop, it is stored in a local JSON file at ~/.yt-deluxe/history.json. No data is ever synced to any cloud or remote server.
privacyPolicy.prefsLanguageDetail: Stored locally on your device only
privacyPolicy.q3Text: When you search or download, your requests go through the backend via yt-dlp. YouTube's own Privacy Policy and Terms of Service apply to all interactions with their platform. No other third-party services receive your data.
privacyPolicy.ytGoogleDesc: Their Privacy Policy and Terms of Service govern all interactions with their platform.
privacyPolicy.noServicesDesc: No analytics providers, ad networks, or data brokers receive any information.
privacyPolicy.firstPrinciple: We operate under a Sovereignty First principle. You own the metadata, you own the storage, and you control what is kept.
privacyPolicy.zeroExfiltrationDesc: Browser history stays in localStorage. It never touches our servers.
privacyPolicy.localFilesDesc: Desktop users have full visibility of download_history.json in their home directory. Delete it anytime.
privacyPolicy.noAnalyticsDesc: No tracking pixels, cookies, heatmaps, or crash reporters are used. Ever.
privacyPolicy.ephemeral: On the web-hosted version, media files are processed in a temporary server folder and automatically deleted after 10 minutes. No user data is retained between sessions.

about.architectureDesc: Built for those who demand more than just a download button.
about.visionText1: YT Deluxe was born from a simple necessity: the modern web requires a resilient, uncompromising tool for media preservation. In an era of ephemeral content, having a local, high-fidelity archive isn't a luxury it's essential.
about.visionText2: This system isn't just a wrapper; it's a dedicated engine. Every component, from the glassmorphic interface to the concurrent download daemon, is engineered to balance aesthetic beauty with raw technical capability.

terms.title: Terms & Conditions
terms.subtitle: Usage guidelines and legal framework for YT Deluxe.
terms.eulaDesc: Please read these terms carefully before using YT Deluxe.
terms.acceptanceText1: By downloading, installing, or using YT Deluxe, you agree to be bound by these terms. If you do not agree to these terms, do not use the application.
terms.acceptanceText2: YT Deluxe is provided "as is", intended strictly for educational, research, and non-commercial media preservation.
terms.fairUseDesc: Users are solely responsible for the content they download.
terms.fairUseText: You agree to respect the intellectual property rights of content creators. This tool must not be used to bypass DRM, distribute copyrighted material commercially, or violate the terms of service of any supported platform.

aboutUs.aboutText1: YT Deluxe is a free, open-source, full-stack media management application that lets you search, preview, and download YouTube videos and audio - with a beautifully crafted Liquid Glass UI that feels premium.
aboutUs.aboutText2: Most downloaders are flooded with ads, malware, confusing interfaces, and paywalls. YT Deluxe was built to fix all of that: 100% ad-free, self-hosted, with no trackers, supporting 144p to 8K across multiple formats. Think of it as your personal YouTube client - clean, fast, and fully yours.
aboutUs.futureText1: YT Deluxe is continuously evolving. Our roadmap includes playlist batch downloading, subtitle embedding, and native progress notifications.
aboutUs.futureText2: We are also exploring cloud sync for download history, mobile PWA support, and a plugin system for custom post-processors.
aboutUs.feat1Desc: Search YouTube by keyword or paste a direct URL. Browse rich video cards with thumbnails, durations, view counts, and hover previews.
aboutUs.feat2Desc: Download from 144p up to 8K. Supports MP4, MKV, WebM, M4A, Opus, and MP3 with automatic FFmpeg merging for best quality.
aboutUs.feat3Desc: Frame-accurate start and end point selection with a live preview player. Download only the exact segment you need.
aboutUs.feat4Desc: Choose exact codec streams, container formats, and audio bitrates. Full control over what you download and how.
aboutUs.feat5Desc: Runs seamlessly as a web app in any browser or as a fully native Windows desktop application (.exe installer).
aboutUs.feat6Desc: No tracking, no telemetry, no accounts. All history and preferences stay on your device, never on a server.
aboutUs.feat7Desc: Available in English, Hindi, German, and Hinglish with full i18n support for easy community contributions.
aboutUs.feat8Desc: Track, filter, and manage all your downloads. Bulk delete, storage usage monitor, and re-download support built in.
aboutUs.devDesc: Passionate about building high-performance, aesthetically stunning systems. YT Deluxe represents a fusion of technical robustness and premium Liquid Glass design, with a focus on user experience, privacy, and open-source values.
aboutUs.footerBanner: Free & Open Source - GPL-3.0 - Non-Commercial Intent
aboutUs.footerText: 2026 YT Deluxe. Built by Utsav Parmar. Powered by React & yt-dlp.

termsCond.mutualAgreementDesc: By downloading, installing, or using YT Deluxe, you agree to these terms. If you do not agree, do not use this software. Continued use after any update implies acceptance of the revised terms.
